title: Sample ride · TT bike on a trainer

coach.text:
Position summary for Triathlon / Time trial.

Here is what to work on, in order of importance:

1. Hips rock on the saddle. Your hips move about 19 mm up and down each stroke. More than ~15 mm usually means the saddle is a touch high or the cleats are too far forward.

2. Flatten your back: shorten the reach or raise the bars. Your back rounds by 13.7% of its length (about 59 mm of curve). Try a stem 10 mm shorter or one 5 mm spacer under it, then roll the pelvis forward and hinge from the hips.

Golden rule: change one thing at a time, in small steps, ride for a few days, then re-test. Comfort and pain-free riding always beat textbook numbers.
